entities.summary: Benedikt is the central settlement in the Municipality of Benedikt in northeastern Slovenia. Before 1998, it was part of the Municipality of Lenart. It lies in the Slovene Hills. The area is part of the traditional region of Styria. It is now included in the Drava Statistical Region.
